title: Bali Tour Package for Couple Including Flights
highlights: Indulge in a dreamy escape with Bali tour packages for couple including flights, offering a romantic sunset at Tanah Lot and scenic views of Mount Batur.
Admire the beauty of Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, nestled on the shores of Lake Beratan, known for its serene atmosphere and amazing backdrop.

overview:
About the destinations:
Bali, often referred to as the "Island of the Gods," is a captivating destination renowned for its stunning landscapes, rich culture, and vibrant arts scene. Among its many enchanting locales, Ubud and Kuta stand out as two of the most popular areas for travellers. Ubud, nestled in the lush interior, is known for its picturesque rice terraces, tranquil environment, and thriving artistic community. Here, couples can immerse themselves in the serene beauty of nature, visit traditional markets, and explore numerous art galleries and workshops. The town's yoga studios and wellness retreats make it an ideal spot for couples seeking relaxation and rejuvenation.


On the other hand, Kuta offers a vibrant beach atmosphere filled with lively nightlife, shopping, and water sports. This bustling beach destination is famous for its golden sandy shores and exhilarating surf waves, making it perfect for adventurous couples. As the sun sets, Kuta transforms into a hub of activity, with numerous beach clubs and restaurants offering a lively ambiance to unwind and enjoy a romantic dinner by the sea. With such contrasting yet complementary experiences, Bali tour packages for couple including flights can provide the perfect blend of relaxation and excitement.


Whether you choose to explore the serene rice paddies of Ubud or the energetic vibe of Kuta, Bali promises a memorable escape for couples. To make the most of your trip, consider a Bali package for couple with airfare that includes essential amenities and curated experiences tailored to create lasting memories in this tropical paradise. Embrace the enchanting culture, indulge in mouthwatering cuisine, and discover the beauty of Bali together.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Ubud | Candlelight Dinner
days.desc: After your flight from Delhi, arrive at the airport in Ubud, and get transferred to the hotel to check in. Relax for a while and then treat yourself to a romantic candlelight dinner with delicious cuisines in an intimate setting, a perfect start to your romantic getaway. Later, spend an overnight stay at the hotel.

days.title: Bedugul Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Kick off your adventure by boarding your transfer for a scenic tour of Bedugul. Explore the iconic Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, which floats peacefully on the lake. Also, visit the famous Bali Handara Gate, set against the backdrop of the surrounding Mount Batur. Further, head to Tanah Lot, a stunning sea temple perched on a rocky outcrop, known for its spectacular sunsets. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, set out to visit Tegallalang Rice Terraces to wander through lush, green fields and admire the scenic views. Next, visit the Tegenungan Waterfall, feeling the refreshing spray of the cascading water as you capture photos of its natural beauty. Then, head to the Kintamani Highlands, where panoramic views of Mount Batur and its volcanic crater await. Finally, experience the thrill of the Bali Swing, soaring high above the jungle and rice terraces, before getting driven to the hotel in Ubud.

days.title: Transfer to Kuta | Leisure Day
days.desc: Check out of the hotel in Ubud and get driven to Kuta, Bali’s vibrant beach destination. Upon arrival, check in and enjoy a leisurely day with your partner. You can visit the Vihara Dharmayana Temple, a serene Buddhist temple with intricate architecture, or head to Gunung Payung Beach, where you can stroll hand in hand along the secluded shoreline. For a shopping spree, you can explore Mal Bali Galeria before returning to the hotel on your own for a relaxing evening together.

days.title: Uluwatu Temple Tour with Water Sports
days.desc: Start your day with exciting water sports at Tanjung Benoa, where you can experience thrilling activities (at an extra cost) like jet skiing, parasailing, or snorkelling in crystal-clear waters. Afterward, get driven to Uluwatu Temple, perched dramatically on a cliff above the Indian Ocean. Enjoy the amazing views and a stunning sunset before witnessing the captivating Kecak fire dance performance, a traditional Balinese spectacle. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

Also, indulge in a relaxing Balinese spa experience, where you and your partner can unwind with traditional massages and soothing treatments. This day lets you recharge amidst the beauty of Bali before your unforgettable trip concludes.
